title: SN TOOL STUDIO PRO - Official Release v2.0.0 (Grand Studio 2.0 & Turbo Downloader Engine)
release_notes:
• 🌟 SN TOOL STUDIO PRO 2.0.0 MILESTONE RELEASE: Major architectural upgrade delivering full stability, turbo download speeds, and seamless multi-platform streaming.
• 🚀 Turbo Downloader Engine & Multi-Platform Resolution: Fully resolved stream candidate fetching for AnyReel, ShortMax, ReelShort, FreeReels, and English-title dramas, enabling seamless HD download across all 45+ episodes!
• 🛡️ Accurate Download Queue Sync: Completely eliminated false 100% completion in the UI by synchronizing real disk and download thread statuses.
• ⚡ Deterministic Multi-Episode Stream Cluster: Smart hash-based stream binding ensures each episode downloads its authentic distinct video file instead of single-stream master movies.
• 📁 Auto-Player Preview On-Demand: Integrated live 9:16 stream resolver allowing real-time playback in SN Studio even before files finish downloading locally.
• 🔄 1-Click OTA Client Update Verification: Full bytecode sync and update automation.
